graph_operations: phase = exp(1j*(kx*x - kz*z))  [constant wrt head params]
E_y = sum(phase * coeff)  [linear in coeff, hence linear in head params]
de_dx, de_dz via autograd  [linear in head params since E_y is linear]
PDE residual = linear function of E_y, H_x, H_z  [linear in head params]
DtN residual: DFT(E_scat) and DFT(H_scat)  [linear in head params]
MSE = ||r||^2  [quadratic in head params, residual vector linear]
CONCLUSION: E_y, H_x, H_z, and all residual rows are AFFINE in head params
conclusion: Hidden features are computed from frozen z-basis parameters only (MLP[0] and MLP[1] are frozen). The final head MLP[2] is a plain Linear layer with no post-activation. Therefore E_y, H_x, H_z, and all residual rows are affine functions of the final-head parameters.
